title: OroTitan Analytical Data Contracts V2 V0.1
description: Additive machine-readable analytical working-artifact contracts. No scoring, valuation-policy or canonical snapshot authority.

cross_object_rules: referenced IDs must resolve against exact active or pinned lineage
admitted current-run evidence must satisfy source_date <= data_cutoff
supporting and contradicting evidence overlap requires explicit conflict semantics
material changed conclusions require a completed material-change revalidation record before final sealing
JSON Schema does not replace Process Engine dependency/reopening rules
